# Model

- Inherits [`PVInstance`](pvinstance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Model")`

A group of parts handled as one object, with a pivot to move it by and an extents box to measure it with.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PrimaryPart` | `BasePart?` | — | read/write | The part this model's pivot follows; Clone rewires it to the copy, since it is the reference into a cloned subtree that catches people. |

## Methods

### `GetExtentsSize(): vector`

The size in metres of the smallest box enclosing every part in this model.
